code.originalText: Five-month review with a planned second trial without catheter

text.paragraph: Five-month review with a second trial without catheter. [S]

Mr. Tagore returns after four and a half months of finasteride with tamsulosin for a second trial without catheter. He has had no infection since March, no fever, and no falls. The catheter was removed at seven this morning; he has since passed 240 mL and 210 mL with a slow but steady stream and feels he has emptied reasonably well. He has had no breast tenderness or dizziness. He is pleased and a little wary. [S]

Benign prostatic hyperplasia with severe lower urinary tract symptoms (IPSS 26) and bladder outlet obstruction: prostate about 85 mL on ultrasound, smooth and benign on examination, PSA 4.9 ng/mL (PSA density 0.06)
S — Synthetic modern diagnosis linked to the retrospective enlarged-prostate reading of his last illness; the conflicting cancer claim is not adopted.
Urinary retention with severe lower urinary tract symptoms (bladder scan 640 mL after voiding) and a raised creatinine, cause under evaluation
S — Synthetic presenting concern at the index visit, superseded by the diagnosis of benign prostatic hyperplasia with chronic retention at the two-week visit.
Chronic urinary retention from bladder outlet obstruction, low risk once drained (no hydronephrosis; creatinine normal after drainage), managed with an indwelling urethral catheter
S — Synthetic diagnosis; resolved after a successful second trial without catheter.
Catheter-associated urinary tract infection with fever, without sepsis; resolved
S — Synthetic complication of the synthetic catheter at an unscheduled visit; it echoes, without asserting, the urinary infections of his documented last illness.
Mild frailty (Clinical Frailty Scale 5): slow gait (Timed Up and Go 15 seconds), needs help with heavy housework and travel; cognition normal (Mini-Cog 4)
S — Synthetic geriatric assessment before the surgical decision.

Infection and inflammatory reaction due to indwelling urethral catheter, initial encounter

list.item:
Chronic urinary retention, resolved after the second trial without catheter (R33.8). Post-void residual 150 mL after two good voids: the trial has succeeded. A residual of this size is above normal but well below the retention range, and is acceptable with monitoring. Creatinine 1.12 mg/dL (eGFR 66). [S]
Catheter left out.
Bladder scan and IPSS in four weeks and at three months; recatheterize and see urology if the residual is over 300 mL, if he cannot pass urine, or if infection or kidney changes occur.
Double voiding, voiding by the clock every three to four hours, and avoiding decongestants and anticholinergic medicines.

Benign prostatic hyperplasia, moderate symptoms on combination therapy (N40.1). IPSS 13 with a quality-of-life score of 3, down from 26 and 5. PSA 2.6 ng/mL after four and a half months of finasteride, about half the baseline of 4.9, as expected (5.2 ng/mL when doubled); no concern. [S]
Continue tamsulosin 0.4 mg at bedtime and finasteride 5 mg daily.
Repeat PSA at about a year on finasteride, doubled for interpretation.
Surgery remains available if retention returns, as agreed.

list.item: Bladder drained and kidney function back to normal within two weeks. Outcome by 2026-03-03: Creatinine 1.42 mg/dL at presentation, 1.18 mg/dL after two weeks of drainage; no hydronephrosis [S]

No catheter-associated infection, or prompt treatment if one occurs. Outcome by 2026-03-31: One febrile catheter-associated infection at four weeks, treated in clinic for 7 days without admission; resolved [S]

A treatment decision that he understands and that fits his values, after a geriatric assessment, by about ten weeks. Outcome by 2026-04-28: Chose to continue the catheter with tamsulosin and finasteride and to try again without the catheter after three to four months, deferring surgery; recorded in his own words [S]
Voiding without a catheter, with a post-void residual under 300 mL, by about five months. Outcome by 2026-07-14: Second trial without catheter succeeded: residual 150 mL, IPSS 13 [S]
Goals of care and a health care agent recorded. Outcome by 2026-06-09: Goals of care discussed at the ten-week visit; health care agent named and his wishes recorded at the wellness visit [S]
